schools.notes: BGSU CDS is embedded as a Tableau dashboard (not a PDF). Cannot extract C11 or C21 data programmatically. Page exists but no PDF is published.
UND CDS 2024-25 not yet published as of 2026-04-30. Page states 'Updated reports will be available soon.'
Curtis Institute is a specialized music conservatory with audition-based admissions. No standard CDS PDF found publicly. GPA distribution and ED/EA data not applicable to their admissions process.
NEC is a specialized music conservatory with audition-based admissions. No publicly accessible CDS PDF found. C11 GPA distribution and C21 ED/EA data not typically published for music schools.
Juilliard is a specialized performing arts school with audition-based admissions. Admissions data page returns 403. No standard CDS PDF found. GPA distribution and ED/EA not applicable.
NMSU does not publish CDS PDF publicly. OIA website provides only factbooks, census reports, and dashboards. Last known CDS PDF (2018-19) is now returning 404. No 2023-24 or 2024-25 CDS found.
The New School does not appear to publish its CDS as a publicly accessible PDF. Institutional Research page links to IPEDS, MSCHE, and survey data but not CDS. Archives only contain 2008-09 CDS.
UT Arlington provides admissions data through SAS-based interactive dashboards (not PDFs). No CDS PDF found on uta.edu. Their analytics portal has pipeline and funnel data but not in CDS format.
